== Image injection for Android apps

- Fixed an issue where installing an Android app with *Instrument application for camera injection* enabled failed with a `Failed to instrument` error when the app was built with R8 code optimization. These apps now install with instrumentation, and image injection works in camera preview frames and captured photos.
- Improved image injection for Android apps that use Camera2 or CameraX, including apps that scan QR codes from camera frames.
- Instrumentation now stops with a message that identifies the unsupported file format when an app uses method handles, which automated instrumentation cannot modify.
